ratio_definition: median of fifteen same-image/same-round numerator/denominator ratios; equal-weight aggregation uses one paired median per image; never ratio of absolute medians
quantiles: descriptive linear interpolation at p*(n-1); no confidence/significance claim
zero_policy: A zero numerator gives ratio0 and a zero geometric mean; denominator0 rejects the summary. Timer-resolution zeros cannot establish zero computation cost.
limitation: Single local run; scheduler/thermal/code-layout effects remain. V11 and linear adapters copy Result vectors within adapter wall time; direct uses its native result vector. Internal search is the primary algorithm comparison. No accuracy-improvement or universal speed claim.
